title: Chapter 6830: Who Are You?

Chapter 6830: Who Are You?

Chapter 6830: Who Are You?

“Go!” Goldsilver sent all of his leaves against Absolute.

“Relax.” Absolute used the ocean of lightning to deal with the leaves, preventing them from getting close.

“You want to die first or them?” He asked the defenders.

“Either way.” Blaze and the others prepared to die and spoke while arching their chest proudly.

“Take out the shrine and be spared a horrific death.” He seemed to enjoy the suffering and despair of others, especially the masses.

Thunder Emperor stepped forward, wanting to die first before Li Qiye. The latter smiled and also walked forward.

“Stand back.” Thunder told him.

“Leave it to me.” He smiled at them.

“Such a courageous mortal, amazing.” Absolute didn’t bother to use his divinity against a mortal.

“Don’t come closer!” Ironleaf shouted.

A mortal standing before an overlord was insane. However, Li Qiye still had a nonchalant expression.

“Your Devouring Alliance only has small fries now?” Li Qiye said with a smile.

“Am I talking to a hidden master?” Absolute laughed: “I’m curious now.”

He took a closer look at Li Qiye and didn’t notice anything.

“Not hiding anything, I’m just me.” Li Qiye shook his head:” It’s just that I’m disappointed because the once-strongest alliance has no one worthwhile. Not even an immortal has shown up after all this time. Sigh, looks like the golden age is over for your alliance, only nobodies are here to prance around.”

Six-foot and the others were left speechless upon hearing this.

“Haha, reveal yourself then!” Absolute reached for Li Qiye.

As an overlord, he trusted his assessment. Nevertheless, he still used a grasp containing lightning and the will to devour. It could instantly extinguish ten million miles of land and reduce all life to ashes.

“Pop!” Li Qiye glanced at it and exerted his will, crushing the hand into bloody mist. The lightning bolts dissipated and became feeble.

“Ahh!” Absolute screamed in agony and retreated, unable to create a new hand from the lasting damage.

“Kneel.” Li Qiye ordered.

“Pop!” His legs exploded into blood. The lack of legs didn’t mean an overlord couldn’t stand. However, he was in Li Qiye’s presence.

Spectators were left speechless, whether it be Tinyleaf City Lord or the ancient ancestors. A mortal just defeated an overlord by looking at him?

By this time, Goldsilver Tree finally made it through the ocean of lightning. He arrived and witnessed the outcome, only to stand in a daze.

“H-how did you do it...” He stammered.

Li Qiye only smiled in response while Absolute felt fear once more.

“Who are you?” He had seen immortals in the past and had previously experienced the power of the Bear Immortal. However, they were nothing compared to this mortal.
